svg.aria-label: High level architecture, no database. Sources: 8 CSV files (7 Olist exports and regions.csv). Python: config.py checks the inputs; analysis.ipynb applies the rules, with 11 asserts, and writes 5 CSV files; sql/checks.sql matches 6 totals. Power BI: Power Query loads the CSV files into a star schema of 7 tables, 4 relationships and 5 region roles; 23 DAX measures. Report pages: 5 pages and 56 visuals, 43 checks.
svg.title: Sales performance architecture

g.text: No database: Python writes CSV files, Power BI loads them; powerbi/build_pbip.py writes the Power BI project
